SELECT 'daily_sales' AS source, date::text AS ts, sku, units_sold::text AS v1, revenue_inr::text AS v2, NULL::text AS v3
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-05-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', audit_ts::text, sku, status, NULL, NULL
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', date::text, sku, book_on_hand_close::text, NULL, NULL
FROM store.inventory_book
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-05-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', date::text, sku, forecast_units_per_day::text, sigma::text,
       'book='||book_on_hand||',rop='||reorder_point||',upto='||order_up_to||',ordered='||ordered_units
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-05-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', count_ts::text, sku, 'book='||book_before, 'counted='||counted, 'adjustment='||adjustment||',trigger='||trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', date::text, sku, units::text, reason, NULL
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY source, ts;

SELECT audit_ts, sku, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts <  TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold)
   FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
     AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS units_from_daily_sales,
  (SELECT SUM(qty)
   FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
     AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS units_from_pos_lines,
  (SELECT SUM(line_amount)
   FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
     AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS revenue_from_pos_lines,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS first_sales_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS last_sales_date;

UNION ALL

FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'writeoffs', date::text, units::text, reason, NULL
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'audits_all_skus', audit_ts::text, sku, status, NULL

SELECT 'pos_hourly' AS section, bill_ts::date::text AS d, date_trunc('hour', bill_ts)::time::text AS h,
       SUM(qty)::text AS units, COUNT(*)::text AS lines, NULL::text AS extra
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-08' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-14'
GROUP BY bill_ts::date, date_trunc('hour', bill_ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_hourly', bill_ts::date::text, date_trunc('hour', bill_ts)::time::text,
       SUM(qty)::text, COUNT(*)::text, NULL
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-22' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29'
GROUP BY bill_ts::date, date_trunc('hour', bill_ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'adjustments', adjusted_ts::text, sku, units::text, cases::text, reason||' | '||slot||' | '||value_at_cost_inr
FROM warehouse.stock_adjustments
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'receipt_mismatch', received_ts::text, grn_id||'/'||line, asn_sku||' -> '||sku_booked,
       asn_units::text||' -> '||units_booked::text, sscc
FROM store.goods_receipts
WHERE asn_sku <> sku_booked OR asn_units <> units_booked
ORDER BY section, d, h;

SELECT 'shelf_audit_summary' AS section, sku, COUNT(*) AS audits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf') AS on_shelf,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='empty') AS empty,
       MIN(audit_ts)::text AS first_audit, MAX(audit_ts)::text AS last_audit
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY sku
UNION ALL
SELECT 'payment_notes', note, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, MIN(ts)::text, MAX(ts)::text
FROM payments.pos_payments
WHERE note IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY note
UNION ALL
SELECT 'complaints', kind, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, MIN(complaint_ts)::text, MAX(complaint_ts)::text
FROM payments.customer_complaints
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY section, sku;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS section, sku, MIN(date)::text AS first_d, MAX(date)::text AS last_d,
       COUNT(*)::text AS rows_n, SUM(units_sold)::text AS units
FROM store.daily_sales
GROUP BY sku
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines', sku_scanned, MIN(bill_ts::date)::text, MAX(bill_ts::date)::text,
       COUNT(*)::text, SUM(qty)::text
FROM store.pos_lines
GROUP BY sku_scanned
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', sku, MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text, NULL
FROM store.forecasts
GROUP BY sku
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', sku, MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text, NULL
FROM store.inventory_book
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY section, sku;

SELECT 'warehouse_adjustments' AS section, adjusted_ts::text AS ts, sku, units::text AS v1, reason AS v2, slot AS v3
FROM warehouse.stock_adjustments
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', count_ts::text, sku, book_before::text, counted::text, adjustment::text||' | '||trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE adjustment <> 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'receipt_mismatch', received_ts::text, grn_id||'/'||line, asn_sku||' -> '||sku_booked,
       asn_units::text||' -> '||units_booked::text, sscc
FROM store.goods_receipts
WHERE asn_sku <> sku_booked OR asn_units <> units_booked
ORDER BY section, ts;
